Rubble.text: Broken stone lies in a loose scatter, with sharp fresh faces among the weathered pieces.

Sand.text: Fine grains collect in the shallow hollows; the higher ridges have been swept nearly smooth.

SandstoneWall.text: Packed grains show through the worn face of the stone. Its layers make faint bands across the wall.

Rock.text: An uneven mass of stone, broad enough to interrupt the path around it.

Grass.text: Narrow blades crowd the ground, bending over older growth at their roots.

StoneFloor.text: The exposed stone has been worn smoother along the places feet keep finding.

StoneWall.text: Close-set stone fills the space from side to side. Small chips have gathered at its foot.

LimestoneWall.text: Pale stone, dull on its weathered face and lighter where a corner has chipped away.

ShaleWall.text: Thin dark layers lie pressed together. At the broken edges they separate like pages.

SlateWall.text: Dense, dark stone with flat cleavage lines and a faint blue cast.

QuartziteWall.text: Small bright grains are locked into a hard, uneven face. They catch the light at different angles.

ObsidianWall.text: Dark volcanic glass curves around old fractures. The broken edges have a much finer line than the weathered face.

SandstoneFloor.text: A granular stone surface with shallow hollows where softer bands have worn away.

LimestoneFloor.text: Pale stone underfoot, marked by a loose dust that gathers in its small pits.

ShaleFloor.text: Flat flakes overlap along the dark stone. Their exposed edges give the surface a ragged grain.

SlateFloor.text: Broad, close-fitting planes of dark stone make a surface broken by narrow seams.

QuartziteFloor.text: The stone is speckled with hard pale grains. Worn patches interrupt its rougher surface.

ObsidianFloor.text: Black glass shows dull patches of wear between curved, reflective fractures.

StairsDown.text: The treads descend beyond the lip of the opening. Their edges have rounded under passing feet.

StairsUp.text: A close flight of steps rises toward the opening above. The middle of each tread is worn.

Bank.text: A strip of ground follows the water. Small ridges mark where the edge has stood before.

CampfireGroundMarker.text: Repeated fires have darkened this patch of earth. Fine ash has worked into the cracks.

WellGroundMarker.text: Flagstones beneath the drawing place are worn into shallow channels by spilled water.

OvenGroundMarker.text: A scatter of soot works its way into the joints between the stones.

LanternGroundMarker.text: The stone beneath the lantern bears old splashes and the scuffs of people stopping beside it.

AlchemyStill.text: A receiving vessel sits below a coiled condenser. The still separates a mixture one patient drop at a time.

TinkersForge.text: A hearth and work surface share the same worn reach. Fitting a blade, haft and binding here makes a working weapon.

Pillar.text: A solid stone shaft occupies the space between its broad foot and the structure above.

BrokenColumn.text: The surviving section ends in an irregular break. Its fallen pieces have settled around the base.

WoodenBarrel.text: Curved wooden staves meet beneath tight hoops. The rim is polished where hands have tipped the barrel.

LockedDoor.text: Wooden panels surround a fitted lock. The hinges and keyhole have received more care than the face of the door.

LockedChest.text: A lock plate is set into the front of this wooden chest. Scratches gather around the keyhole.

Oven.text: A deep baking chamber sits behind a narrow mouth. Soot has settled where the heat passes out.

WatchLantern.text: A guarded lamp with a broad base, made to stand at a place people return to.

Urn.text: A clay vessel with a rounded shoulder and narrow mouth. Its thick rim is smoother than the body.

StrongBox.text: Iron plates enclose a compact box. The lid meets a close-set lock plate.

OreCache.text: Rough mineral fragments have been gathered into a sheltered recess. Finer dust fills the spaces between them.

BoneCache.text: Bones have been fitted into a compact pile. Narrow gaps run beneath the larger pieces.

Reliquary.text: A carefully fitted case with a lock across its opening. The care taken over the outside says little about what remains inside.

WeaponRack.text: Wooden rests are spaced to keep hafts and blades apart. Repeated lifting has polished their upper edges.

AlchemyShelf.text: A wooden shelf with narrow compartments and circular stains where vessels have stood.

Bone.text: A pale length of bone, worn smooth on the outside and porous at its broken end.

GoldCoin.text: A small gold coin with a worn rim. The stamped face has been rubbed down to a shallow relief.

SteelBladeComponent.text: An unmounted steel blade with a bare tang. It can become a long blade at a forge, or supply metal to repair damaged metal gear.

IronSpikeComponent.text: An iron point with a thick base left for mounting. Its narrow tip concentrates the force of a thrust.

OakHaftComponent.text: A straight oak haft, shaped at one end to receive a weapon head. The grain runs along its length.

WillowHaftComponent.text: A slim willow haft with a smoothly pared grip. The mounting end is still bare.

LeatherBindingComponent.text: A long strip of leather cut for a firm winding. It can bind a weapon grip or help repair damaged leather gear.

SerratedEdgeComponent.text: A set of close-set teeth and fastenings for dressing an edge. It is a finishing component, not a blade by itself.

FireMoss.text: A warm, brittle mat of moss. Loose crumbs catch with a tiny spark.

LampOil.text: A slow, greasy oil that clings to its container. It serves both the still and a torch in need of fuel.

EmberFruit.text: The flesh holds a lingering warmth beneath its sweetness. Alchemists keep it among their heating ingredients.

FrostLichen.text: Rime outlines the little fronds. Even a brief touch leaves an ache in the fingertips.

GlacierSalt.text: Large, cold crystals fit tightly against one another. When crushed, they leave a fine binding powder.

GlimmerBrine.text: The brine gives off a sharp smell. A faint hum follows the vessel when it is moved.

SparkRoot.text: Fine root-hairs stand around the severed end. Nearby loose hairs rise to meet them.

VenomGland.text: A small gland with its duct still attached. The swollen part holds what the fang once delivered.

BogSap.text: Thick sap draws into reluctant threads. Its sour smell persists after the container is closed.

CandyHeartRoot.text: A thick heartroot with a faint, slow beat. Its mild taste gives little warning of the life in it.

MendleafSprig.text: Small bruised leaves curl around the stem. The torn edges are drawing together again.

StoneburrSeed.text: A hard seed with a knuckled shell. Its crushed substance binds into a close, stiff mass.

BlastcapSpore.text: A gathered blastcap spore, kept apart from heat and careless shaking.

SilverSand.text: Fine, pale grains flash as they move. Settled together, they look duller than a single grain does.

FireClay.text: Dense clay that keeps the shape pressed into it. It is used to patch fired well linings and cracked batch pans.

WardOil.text: A measured portion of oil kept for the settlement watch lamps. A dark residue rings the mouth of its container.

PaleSalt.text: Pale crystals leave a dry dust wherever they rest. The Curation values things that resist decay, including its supplies.

ChoirIron.text: Heavy ore with an uneven, dark metallic grain. Small reddish crumbs gather along its fractured edges.

GlowQuartz.text: Pale crystal faces catch and carry a nearby gleam. The interior breaks it into smaller points.

Cactus.text: A thick, ribbed stem carries close ranks of spines. The folds leave narrow shadows between them.

CandyCarrotCrop.text: Gladroot grows below a low spray of leaves. The edible part stays tucked beneath the growing bed.

EmberwheatCrop.text: A cultivated grain with narrow leaves and upright stalks. Its heads fill as the plant matures.

Starapple.text: A round fruit with firm skin and a small, star-shaped crown at the stem.

Mushroom.text: A fleshy cap spreads above a short stem. Fine gills fold into the shaded underside.

CookedMeat.text: A portion of meat browned at the edges. The surface has tightened around the softer middle.

RoastedStarapple.text: Heat has wrinkled the skin and softened the flesh beneath it. A little juice has dried along the split.

WildBerries.text: A handful of small berries, some still carrying the fine stems they grew on.

Honeycomb.text: Thin wax walls divide the comb into close cells. Honey clings to the broken edges.

MushroomRing.text: Fungal caps trace a loose ring in the ground. Small new heads crowd beneath the older ones.

ChoirSpine.text: A stiff spine of bone narrows to a piercing tip. The thicker end is smooth enough to grip.

OldWorldPipe.text: A length of old metal pipe, hollow at both ends. One end has been battered flatter than the other.

Sporeblade.text: Fine fungal patterns spread over the blade. The sharpened edge cuts a clean line through them.

FlamingSword.text: The steel blade has a heat-darkened finish near the guard. A broad crosspiece separates the edge from the grip.

IceSword.text: Pale steel catches the light along a long, straight edge. The guard curves clear of the hand.

CryoLance.text: A narrow steel point extends well beyond its reinforced socket. The grip is set behind a small protective collar.

EmberSpear.text: A steel spearhead draws into a long point. Dark bands mark the metal close to its socket.

AcidicDagger.text: The short steel blade is etched around its sharpened point. A close guard keeps the grip clear of the working edge.

VenomDagger.text: A slender dagger with a narrow channel alongside the point. Its grip is well separated from the blade.

ThunderHammer.text: A dense steel head sits across a long handle. Bright metal shows through the worn striking faces.

EchoKnife.text: A thin crystal blade catches light in fine internal lines. Its short grip leaves the cutting edge clear.

SeveranceEdge.text: A long blade with an unbroken sweep from shoulder to point. Its substantial weight gathers forward of the guard.

GlassblownStiletto.text: Glass narrows to an exceptionally fine point. Tiny changes in thickness bend the view through it.

DissolutionMaul.text: A broad steel head sits on a haft made for both hands. Shallow pits mark the metal around its striking faces.

FirstRootGlaive.text: The long wooden haft and curved edge share a continuous grain. Fine living fibers remain beneath the worked surface.

PalimpsestBlade.text: Old strokes and newer sharpening marks cross the steel. Repeated polishing has left only fragments of the decoration.

LoanerDagger.text: A serviceable short blade with a repeatedly wrapped grip. Several hands have worn the same places smooth.

LoanerSpear.text: A plain spear with a carefully reseated head. Marks on the shaft stop where a steady grip begins.

LoanerLongsword.text: A long sword kept in working order through repeated sharpening. Older wear remains beneath the newer edge.

HealingTonic.text: A medicinal dose in a small stoppered vessel. Its label is worn where a thumb finds the grip.

PoisonTonic.text: A tightly stoppered dose with a sharply marked warning. The contents are meant to be handled more carefully than ordinary medicine.

FireTonic.text: A flame mark runs up the side of the vessel. The stopper has been tied down for travel.

AcidTonic.text: A narrow vessel with an acid warning on its wrapping. The mouth is kept well clear of the grip.

LightningTonic.text: A branching mark identifies the dose. Its wrapping leaves only the neck exposed.

FrostTonic.text: A pale frost mark is worked around the neck. The stopper fits below a tightly wound band.

WaterTonic.text: A rounded water mark identifies the stoppered dose. The vessel is small enough to hold in one hand.

BleedTonic.text: A red cut-mark runs across the label. The dose is sealed beneath a close-fitting stopper.

Antidote.text: A measured remedy with its name written plainly. The stopper is broad enough for an unsteady hand.

BurnSalve.text: A thick preparation kept beneath a close lid. A flat scrap tucked into the wrapping serves for spreading it.

Panacea.text: A carefully sealed remedy, its label crowded by the names of several ailments.

SpeedTonic.text: The dose bears a small running figure. Creases in its wrapping converge beneath the stopper.

StrengthTonic.text: A clenched hand marks the vessel. The dose is secured with a short, stout tie.

StoneskinTonic.text: A stone pattern is drawn around the label. The vessel itself is small enough to fit in a palm.

WaterPuddle.text: A shallow spread of water follows the low places in the ground.

OilSlick.text: A dark film of oil lies over the ground, drawing into thicker beads along the uneven edges.

AcidPool.text: A sharp-smelling pool lies in a shallow depression. A pale line marks its edge.

OilSeep.text: Dark oil has gathered around a narrow opening in the ground. Its heavier folds barely move.

LanternOil.text: A stoppered flask of fuel oil. The outside is rubbed clean where a hand grips it.

Torch.text: A wooden shaft supports a tightly gathered head of fuel. The lower end leaves room for a hand away from the flame.

PoisonGasGrenade.text: A sealed canister marked for poison vapor. Throwing it releases its contents into the surrounding air.

SleepGasGrenade.text: A sealed canister marked for sleep vapor. The cloud released by a throw is not confined to the struck creature.

StunGasGrenade.text: A sealed canister marked for stun vapor. Its charge is meant to spread through the air after a throw.

SpikeTrap.text: A bed of pointed spikes is joined to a pressure mechanism. Narrow seams separate the moving plate from its frame.

FireTrap.text: A small pressure mechanism sits above a fuel outlet. Soot has gathered around the opening.

BearTrap.text: Curved metal jaws meet around a central pressure plate. The hinge is heavier than the teeth.

PressurePlate.text: A fitted plate sits slightly apart from its surround. A narrow linkage disappears beneath its edge.
